# QA plan — workspace-first board planning

## Scope and gate

This plan covers the approved workspace-first board slice in `docs/kanban-redesign.md`: independent logical board workspaces and blank board cards, a separate persisted board snapshot and one-time history import, planning-only board creation after approval, and explicit execution-task handoff.

The implementation artifact documents a delivery blocker: there is currently no non-execution planning-chat/session runtime and no registered `create_board_task` or `update_board_task` native tools. The UI correctly renders **Plan with AI** disabled. Therefore acceptance criterion 3 cannot pass final QA until that runtime and tool path exist. QA must classify the delivery as blocked—not treat the disabled control as a substitute for approval-gated planning.

Five focused cases are planned, one for each acceptance criterion. They use the lowest layer that can establish the behaviour and stay within the ten-case delivery limit.

## Acceptance-criteria test matrix

| ID | Acceptance criterion and focused evidence | Layer and location | Test procedure, expected result, and failure signal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QA-1 | Users can create, select, rename, optionally folder-link, and delete logical board workspaces without changing the VS Code folder. | Unit: extend `src/core/board/__tests__/BoardStore.spec.ts`; focused desktop smoke for the VS Code-folder non-effect. | Create two workspaces, select the second, rename it, set and clear `linkedWorkspacePath`, delete the selected workspace, then reopen `BoardStore` from the same temporary global-storage directory. Assert the selected fallback, surviving workspace metadata, and cascade removal of only the deleted workspace's board tasks. Assert the tested store has no VS Code workspace API dependency. In the desktop smoke, record the open VS Code folder before and after each workspace action and assert it is unchanged. Failure: workspace/card state is lost or wrong after reopen, deletion affects history, or the open folder changes. |
| QA-2 | Users can add completely empty cards directly into every stage, move them, reload, and find them unchanged. | Unit: extend `src/core/board/__tests__/BoardStore.spec.ts`; webview UI: replace/extend `webview-ui/src/components/board/__tests__/TaskBoardView.spec.tsx`. | For each `BoardStage`, create an empty-title card in the selected workspace, move it to a different stage, reopen the store, and assert `title === ""`, its workspace ID, destination stage, and persisted position. In the component test, activate each accessible `Add task to <stage>` action; assert the posted `createBoardTask` payload has that stage, the inserted card's `Task title` input receives focus after the host snapshot update, shows `Untitled task`, and its Start task control is disabled. Failure: blank title is rejected/coerced, card moves/positions are not persisted, card is shown in another workspace, or Add task/focus/accessibility semantics fail. |
| QA-3 | Approved LLM planning adds cards only to the active workspace and does not create execution tasks. | **Blocked integration test:** add `src/core/board/__tests__/BoardPlanningSession.spec.ts` (or the established native-tool test location once the runtime exists). Current UI regression remains in `webview-ui/src/components/board/__tests__/TaskBoardView.spec.tsx`. | **Current required negative check:** assert `Plan with AI` is disabled, exposes its unavailable explanation, and posts neither `newTask` nor a planning/start message. **Required unblock test after implementation:** start a planning session for workspace A, verify its metadata contains only workspace A and optional linked-folder context, attempt `create_board_task` before recorded approval and assert rejection/no mutation, then record approval and create/update a card. Assert the resulting card belongs only to A; attempts to target workspace B, a stale/deleted workspace, or an invalid stage fail with no state mutation. Spy on `createTask`, `newTask`, `TaskHistoryStore`, and execution-history broadcasts: none may be called. Failure: tools are unavailable after the control is enabled, approval is bypassed, cross-workspace mutation succeeds, or any execution task/history record is created. **Blocker:** these public execution-free planning interfaces do not exist in the implementation, so the required positive test cannot be written or passed yet. |
| QA-4 | Starting a titled card creates and links one execution task; completing it moves only that linked card to Done. | Integration: extend `src/core/webview/__tests__/ClineProvider.taskHistory.spec.ts` (or a focused sibling using its provider fixture). | Seed one titled unlinked board card plus a different unlinked card and a card linked to another execution ID. Call `startBoardTask` twice for the seeded card and assert `createTask(title)` is called exactly once, the first card receives that returned ID, and the repeat opens the linked task rather than creating another. Reject a blank/whitespace-only title without calling `createTask`; simulate execution creation failure and assert no link. Trigger completion for the returned execution ID and assert only its linked card moves to Done; the unrelated unlinked and differently linked cards retain their stages. Failure: duplicate execution creation, link after a failed create, blank-card start, or unrelated card movement. |
| QA-5 | Existing history is imported once into an Imported tasks workspace and board actions never delete history. | Unit: extend `src/core/board/__tests__/BoardStore.spec.ts`; integration assertion in the provider fixture only if needed to prove initialization ordering. | Initialize with top-level active and completed history plus child/delegated history. Run initialization/import twice and reopen the store. Assert exactly one `Imported tasks` workspace; exactly one linked card per top-level history item; completed maps to Done, active maps to Backlog; children are absent; and the migration marker remains set. Exercise board-card and workspace deletion, then assert the supplied history fixture and `TaskHistoryStore` deletion spy are unchanged/not called. Also cover empty history: marker persists and no imported workspace is created. Failure: duplicate/child import, wrong stage mapping, a later import after the marker, or any history deletion/write caused by a board action. |

## Required regression and validation evidence

Do not execute the final gate during this planning phase. After the missing planning runtime is implemented, collect the following evidence:

1. Focused unit/integration suites:
   - `pnpm --filter zoo-code exec vitest run core/board/__tests__/BoardStore.spec.ts`
   - `pnpm --filter zoo-code exec vitest run core/webview/__tests__/ClineProvider.taskHistory.spec.ts`
   - `pnpm --filter @roo-code/vscode-webview exec vitest run src/components/board/__tests__/TaskBoardView.spec.tsx`
   - Add and run the exact `BoardPlanningSession`/native-tool focused test command once its source and test location exist; this command cannot be confirmed until the missing public interface is implemented.
2. Affected type checks:
   - `pnpm --filter @roo-code/types check-types`
   - `pnpm --filter zoo-code check-types`
   - `pnpm --filter @roo-code/vscode-webview check-types`
3. One focused desktop extension-host smoke walkthrough: create/select/rename/link/delete a logical workspace without changing the open VS Code folder; add a blank card in a non-Backlog column, move it, reload the webview and restart the extension; verify title, stage, and workspace persistence; verify the five-column horizontal layout, keyboard-reachable column actions, placeholder/focus behaviour, and text-labelled stages in narrow sidebar and editor-tab contexts; start and complete one titled card and confirm only its linked card reaches Done; confirm Settings, Marketplace, dock, existing history, and the standalone per-task Kanban are unchanged.
4. Planning-specific smoke is a release blocker: after the non-execution session and native tools are delivered, use Plan with AI for the selected workspace, verify cards cannot be created before approval, approve, create/update a card, and verify no execution conversation or `HistoryItem` exists. Until this evidence is available, record QA as blocked.

## Blocker classification

**BLOCKED for final acceptance:** the approved LLM-planning acceptance criterion has no implementation path today. `TaskBoardView` deliberately disables Plan with AI, while the delivery has no `BoardPlanningSession`, non-execution model stream, or native `create_board_task` / `update_board_task` definitions and dispatch. Implement and test that execution-free path before final QA; do not reroute planning through normal `newTask`/`createTask`, because that would create execution history and fail QA-3.
